text:
Anya (Growth): Proposal: run a focused PLG micro-experiment using small starter credits + curated prompt packs. Call it 'Prompt Sprint'. Goal: drive 8-12 quick activations per user within 7 days. Anyone object to the scope?

Michael H: No objections. Who are we targeting? webinar registrants, trial signups, or cold signups?

Anya (Growth): Prioritize trial signups and webinar registrants. N=400 total, split 50/50. We want lightweight routing and minimal infra work.

Samir: I can do routing. Plan: label users `ps_sprint_trial` and `ps_sprint_web`. Send 40 starter-tokens, TTL=7d, only to users with <5 requests to avoid rewarding heavy users. Will exclude paid customers.

Jess: Prompt packs: three theme bundles (developer, content-marketing, product-ops). Each bundle gets 3 exemplar prompts + one quickstart usage note. I'll create A/B wording for in-console guidance.

Maya: Metrics: primary = pct with >=3 meaningful requests by day 7. Secondary = average tokens per active user, retention at day 14. Need baseline from prior 30d. @data-bot can you fetch webinar vs trial activation rates and avg requests/day?

data-bot: Query queued: activation_snapshot_ps_v1. Expect results in ~30m. Saved: https://internal.data/reports/activation_snapshot_ps_v1

Michael H: Measurement plan: randomize assignment 1:1 within each cohort (pack A vs pack B). Use previous 2-week synthetic control for uplift. Also collect short NPS-style feedback for 30 users at day 4.

Anya (Growth): Communication plan: Day0 email + in-app CTA, Day1 in-console prompt surfacing, Day4 reminder and small tips. Email copy should be concise and example-driven.

Jess: Draft email copy (variant A):
```
Subject: 40 starter tokens — Try 3 quick prompts that actually ship value
Hi {{first_name}}, use these prompts in the console to get fast wins. Tokens expire in 7 days.
[CTA: Launch prompts]
```
I'll attach the prompt pack files to this thread.

Samir: Routing config (draft):
```
experiment: prompt_sprint_v1
cohorts: ["ps_sprint_trial","ps_sprint_web"]
credit: 40
ttl_days: 7
exclusions: ["paid_customer","credit_last_30d","high_usage"]
```
Posting to #eng-infra when ready.

Maya: Also exclude users in any other active credit experiments. We'll deconflict with Growth ops.

Anya (Growth): Budget = 400 * 40 = 16k tokens. If we see >=10% relative lift in activation we scale to 2k users.

Michael H: Add a qualitative probe: open text quick survey after first request from 20 users to capture friction. Keep it one question.

Jess: I'll produce prompt examples and short in-console tooltips by EOD. Also internationalize the copy for EN/ES.

Samir: Config pushed to staging: https://internal.deploy/experiments/prompt_sprint_v1 (ops link).

data-bot: activation_snapshot_ps_v1 ready and attached to the report link above.

Maya: I'll build the dashboard and set an alert if activation drops vs baseline.

Anya (Growth): Owners: Anya (lead), Jess (prompts & creative), Samir (routing), Maya (analysis). Standup check Friday 10am PT. :rocket:

Michael H: +1. Let's keep copy short and demo-driven.

Jess: Noted. Will upload packs and mockups shortly.

Samir: One ops note: ensure TTL enforcement is idempotent in case of replays. I'll validate with infra.

Anya (Growth): Great work everyone. Ping if overlap with any other campaigns. Rolling Monday unless we hear concerns. :thumbsup:
